atoms.b: Many sports in Britain were limited to ((++wealthy poor)) people with lots of money and free time, but in the Victorian era, things began to change.
During the Industrial Revolution, new laws were introduced to make work ((scary ++safer)) and give workers more ((++free_time punishments)).
((Richer ++Poorer)) people started playing sport more regularly as a way to socialise and stay ((unhealthy ++healthy)).

instruction.text: Sport also became more popular for several other reasons. Read each reason and select the matching image.

feedback.finish: New rules and equipment made sport safer and fairer, and people were paid to play for the first time. Bigger events could also be held across the country due to the invention of the steam train.

instruction.text: Select the four locations on the map to learn more about Britain’s most popular sports.

text: Rugby was invented in 1823 in a school in a town called Rugby! The first official rules were written in 1845.
The first official rules for cricket were created in 1788 in London. In the 1800s, it became one of Britain’s most popular sports.
The world’s oldest football club was created in the city of Sheffield in 1857, and still exists today!
Modern tennis was invented in Birmingham in 1874, and the current rules were actually written by a cricket club in 1875!

atoms.b: Hello Alexander. I heard you’ve created a new ((++football painting)) team for your factory workers!
atoms.sound: Hello Alexander. I heard you’ve created a new football team for your factory workers!

atoms.b: Hi Charles, yes I have! I’m hoping that it will attract more ((animals ++workers)) to my railway ((farm ++factory)) as I will pay them to play for my club.
atoms.sound: Hi Charles, yes I have. I’m hoping that it will attract more workers to my railway factory as I will pay them to play for my club.

atoms.b: It will also benefit the local community by keeping them ((++happy sad)) and entertained.
atoms.sound: It will also benefit the local community by keeping them happy and entertained.

atoms.b: Yes, I agree. With the new laws, we have to give our workers more ((++free_time food)) to socialise and play sports anyway.
atoms.sound: Yes, I agree. With the new laws, we have to give our workers more free time to socialise and play sports anyway.

feedback.finish: Modern football teams such as Arsenal, Manchester United and West Ham were first created in factories. Over time, workers were given weekends off to play matches and were paid to compete for their teams.

feedback.finish: More people started playing to represent their local churches, schools and communities, meaning sports became bigger and more competitive.

instruction.text: Watch the ships travel around the British Empire in the 1800s.

feedback.finish: As a result of Britain’s Empire, many British sports were introduced around the world. The countries on this map are now especially famous for playing rugby and cricket.
